notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wilhelt, adding {W}.
When Wilhelt dies, Myrkul triggers, exiling Wilhelt from your graveyard and creating a token copy of Wilhelt that is an enchantment.
Cast Humility by paying {2}{W}{W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Zombie, adding one mana of any color.
When the Zombie dies, the Wilhelt token triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed, which becomes a 1/1 Zombie without decayed due to Humility.
Repeat from step 4.
